title: Lean Graph Search for Formal Theorem Proving
abstract: arXiv:2610.22339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieving relevant lemmas is crucial for formal theorem proving, enabling provers to build machine-checkable proofs from established mathematical results. Recent retrieval systems match library declarations to a target theorem or its intermediate proof steps, but make limited use of multi-hop dependencies among declarations. These dependencies can reveal supporting lemmas that are not necessarily lexically similar to the target theorem but recur in proofs of related problems. To this end, we propose LeanGraphSearch, a graph-based retrieval method for Lean 4 that constructs a graph from Mathlib's forward dependencies and traverses it to uncover supporting lemmas through multi-hop dependency chains. translated_title: 面向形式化定理证明的Lean图搜索
translated_abstract: 检索相关引理对形式化定理证明至关重要，它使证明器能够基于已有的数学结果构建可机器验证的证明。近期的检索系统将数学库中的声明与目标定理或其证明的中间步骤进行匹配，但对声明之间的多跳依赖关系利用有限。这些依赖关系可以揭示那些与目标定理在词面上不一定相似、但在相关问题的证明中反复出现的支撑引理。为此，我们提出了LeanGraphSearch，这是一种面向Lean 4的基于图的检索方法，它根据Mathlib的前向依赖构建图，并通过遍历该图经由多跳依赖链来发现支撑引理。具体而言，LeanGraphSearch将每个声明与其所依赖的前提相连接，使用基于图的排序算法将相关性从语义匹配的声明传播到其依赖项，并对扩展后的候选结果进行重排序。
tldr: 该论文提出LeanGraphSearch，一种通过构建Mathlib前向依赖图、沿多跳依赖链传播相关性来发现支撑引理的图检索方法，从而提升Lean 4形式化定理证明中的引理检索效果。
